newsitem.title: USA: Foreign crude into the U.S. expected to accelerate.
newsitem.headline: Foreign crude into the U.S. expected to accelerate.

text.p: U.S. crude traders said foreign barrels were expected to see increased arbitrage opportunities in the coming days, putting additional pressure on squeezed U.S. domestic grades.
On Thursday talk in the wet market was modest and lackluster, however, with not much fresh discussed.
"The arbitrage may be getting wider, but it isn't quite there," said a trader.
WTI/Brent November and December spreads were around $1.00-$1.15 most of the session.
